meta.name: Asri Collection App Structure
meta.purpose: Application architecture and UI composition blueprint

architecture.runtime: React 19 npm packages, TypeScript, Vite, Storefront UI React, and Tailwind CSS 4

routing.type: client-side route resolution with product path routes and hash-based placeholder pages
routing.mechanism: window.location.pathname, window.location.hash, history.pushState, popstate, and hashchange
routing.direct_url_fallback: 404.html redirects to the root entry point with the requested path encoded in ?p=; index.html restores the original pathname before React resolves the route.
routing.note: ProductDetail resolves the item_group_id from the URL and renders all catalog variants in that group. Other not-yet-built pages remain placeholders.

principles: Keep the current no-build GitHub Pages architecture.
Keep layout ownership at the application shell level.
Separate page content, reusable UI patterns, data access, and styling responsibilities.
Render Divoom product data from the Supabase get-divoom-products Edge Function; do not add demo product fallbacks.
Treat this file as an architecture reference, not as a claim that conceptual components already exist as separate source files.
Support responsive Mobile (320–767px), Tablet (768–1023px), and Desktop (1024px and above) layouts for Header, Home, and Products.

children.rendering: Exactly one navigation component is rendered according to the active page.

navigation_policy.footer: Footer is rendered inside each page.

AppShell.footer_ownership: Each page owns and renders its own PageFooter.

Main.responsibility: Primary page viewport and scrolling region

PagesLayout.responsibility: Contains page sections; only the active page is visible

OverlayLayout.responsibility: Product detail modal outside the normal document flow

responsive.mobile: single-column hero; vertical intro strip; 2-column featured products
responsive.tablet: two-column hero; horizontal intro strip; 3-column featured products
responsive.desktop: two-column editorial hero; horizontal intro strip; 4-column featured products

responsive.mobile: stacked heading and full-width search; 2-column product grid

ProductDetail.data_resolution: Filter fetched catalog rows by exact item_group_id
ProductDetail.variant_selection: All variants in the group are selectable on the product detail page
ProductDetail.direct_url: Supported through the GitHub Pages 404.html fallback

ProductSearch.behavior: Shared controlled search field used in Header and Products toolbar.

ProductCard.behavior: Navigates to /products/{item_group_id}; does not open ProductQuickView.

ProductQuickView.status: retained as unused legacy component; product cards now navigate to ProductDetailPage

SearchButton.behavior: Navigates to the Search placeholder route

WishlistButton.behavior: Navigates to the Wishlist placeholder route

CartButton.behavior: Navigates to the Cart placeholder route

HeaderSearch.behavior: Submits the current catalog query and opens Products.

rules: Do not query the products table directly from this frontend.
Do not add hardcoded or demo product fallback data.
Validate the HTTP response and Divoom product JSON fields before rendering.
Keep loading, error, retry, and empty states explicit.
field_rules: Prices are numeric IDR values; sale_price may be null.
Use image_link as the primary product image.
additional_image_link is a JSON array of image URLs for the product gallery.
Use product_type for the product category and color for the variant color.
Treat availability values such as in stock and out of stock as catalog status, not as a stock quantity.

styles.styling_policy: Storefront UI components + Tailwind utility classes; no legacy stylesheet

repository_files.index.html: Vite HTML entry and GitHub Pages deep-link restoration.
repository_files.404.html: GitHub Pages fallback copied from public/404.html into dist.
repository_files.tailwind.config.cjs: Storefront UI preset and ASRI design tokens.
repository_files.src/App.tsx: Application routes, product fetching, UI components, and page rendering.
repository_files.src/styles/globals.css: Tailwind layers and minimal base/accessibility rules.
repository_files.blueprint-design-system.json: Structured design-system specification and visual tokens.
repository_files.docs/STOREFRONT_UI_V2_MIGRATION.md: Approved migration requirements and deployment boundary.

constraints: Do not claim Vite, TypeScript, npm scripts, React Router, or a build pipeline are implemented.
Do not add demo product fallback data when the Supabase Edge Function request fails.
Architecture changes must be reflected in this file when the implementation changes.
BottomNavigation is exclusive to Home, Products, and Profile.
BottomActionBar is exclusive to ProductDetail, Search, Cart, Checkout, OrderSuccess, OrderTracking, Wishlist, and Contact.
Do not represent placeholder routes as completed commerce features.
ProductCard navigates to /products/{item_group_id}; ProductQuickView is not the product-card navigation target.
Use React npm packages, Vite, TypeScript, and Storefront UI React; do not restore CDN runtime or Vite TypeScript build.
Use Tailwind utility classes and Storefront UI preset; avoid a bespoke global stylesheet.
ProductCard navigates to /products/{item_group_id}; item_group_id is the product group identifier.
Do not modify the Supabase Edge Function, response contract, database, or backend behavior.

Header.mobile: BrandLockup left; Search, Wishlist, and Cart actions right; MainNavigation and inline HeaderSearch hidden.
Header.tablet: BrandLockup and left-aligned MainNavigation; compact inline HeaderSearch; Wishlist and Cart actions right.
Header.desktop: BrandLockup and left-aligned MainNavigation; inline HeaderSearch; Wishlist and Cart actions right.

navigation_policy.footer: Footer is rendered inside each page.

technology.styling: Tailwind CSS 4.1.14 + Storefront UI Tailwind configuration
